patch.title: Twilio sender registration: a verified toll-free number or an A2P 10DLC brand and campaign

append.detail:
RESUMED 2026-10-19 (ADR-1790). Owner in the project chat: "let's get Twilio set up". PREMISE RE-TESTED: the Twilio rail, the outbox, the signed webhook with STOP, the verified opt-in with rate limits and /admin/sms are all built; migration 20260626010000 (sms_consent) IS applied in production (pg_tables and schema_migrations read 2026-10-19), so the older "unapplied in prod" notes above are stale; no TWILIO_* or SMS_* key exists in Vercel yet. CODE: the gate now also opens on SMS_TOLLFREE_VERIFICATION_SID (a verified toll-free number, no brand, no campaign, no TCR fees) beside the 10DLC pair; START / UNSTOP / YES lift a STOP on the ledger; inbound replies are empty TwiML. Filing paths: docs/A2P-REGISTRATION.md §3-§4 (10DLC) or §8 (toll-free). STILL OWNER: buy the number, submit the verification or the brand and campaign, set the keys in Vercel, point the Messaging Service webhooks at /api/webhooks/twilio, run one consented test. Closes when SMS_PROVISIONING_ENABLED, TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID and one registration id are set on Vercel Production and a consented test text is delivered.

ABSORBED 2026-10-20: PROG-GD6 merged into this row (phase plan, /mnt/project-files/phases/plan-2026-10-20.md). Their open work and close conditions now belong here.
